description: A coloring book lies open on the yellow desk, showing a mostly colored lobster on the right page, with a box of 64 Crayola crayons sitting ahead near the back. The left hand rests near the open book while the right hand moves forward toward the crayon box, dips in to touch and select a crayon, then withdraws back toward the book, leaving the crayons in the box and the desk as the stable surface.
